data.title: 爱蜜莉雅 · 甜品店
data.description: 【爱蜜莉雅 · 甜品店】现代步行街热闹的甜品店内，换上便服短裙的爱蜜莉雅正像个纯真的孩子一样，两眼放光地盯着面前巨大的彩虹水果圣代——「哇！这个叫‘圣代’的甜点看起来好厉害！里面竟然有这么多没见过的甜甜果子！昴，我们可以开动了吗？」
data.promptProse: Emilia studies the fruit parfait curiously at the cafe table before enjoying it with a pleased smile, her comfortable casual outfit distinct from court attire. The medium view keeps her hands, layered glass dessert and nearby dishes together, seating receding behind. Bright warm cafe light illuminates fruit and cream ridges, while window daylight passes through the glass and catches her silver hair, casting a small rounded dessert shadow on the tabletop.
